notes:
PART=global (backbone_global.json), built 2026-11-05. Weights = change in target SSU per +1 source SSU (nodes_seed.json); arithmetic in each mechanism.

GROUNDING. (1) RBI Monetary Policy Report Oct-2026 (fetched, rbi.org.in PublicationsView id=24085): crude +10% -> CPI +~50 bps (full pass-through), GDP -15 bps; INR -5% -> CPI +40 bps, GDP +25 bps short term; global growth -100 bps -> India GDP -30 bps. (2) Own OLS on market_impact/data/prices/close.csv (weekly 3y/5y, monthly 5y) for every market-observable pair (DXY->INR/CNY/gold/copper/aluminium/cotton, Brent->INR/sugar/soy, gold->silver, VIX/US10Y->S&P/DXY/gold, Fed->10Y, ore->HRC, gas->coal). (3) 2024-base CPI food weight 36.75% (ET 2026-01-29). (4) Dated 2026 news via Google News RSS for regime facts. Everything else is labelled model knowledge with lower confidence.

REGIME CONTEXT (affects which edges are 'live'): US-Iran war since ~Mar-2026 with Strait of Hormuz disruption (IEA: ~10 mb/d Gulf output offline Aug-2026; Brent avg $114 Sep-2026, $95 on 2026-11-05; Iran-Qatar 2-day reopening proposal 2026-11-02). Indian retail fuel hiked ~Rs5/l in May-2026 then frozen. RBI hiked to 5.50% on 2026-10-07; INR ~94.5 near record low with heavy RBI intervention and a USD/INR swap facility; CPI 5.54% (Sep-2026), food 7.74%; deficient monsoon + El Nino risk. US-India: interim deal (18%) Feb-2026, SCOTUS IEEPA ruling, S301 forced-labour tier 10% from 2026-07-24, 100% tariff threat over Russian crude (Sep-2026) eased Oct-2026; US midterms 2026-11-03.

SCOPE CHOICES. Global->Indian bridge edges only for macro/finance (Brent/INR/DXY/US10Y/Fed/VIX/flows -> CPI, GDP, repo, G-sec, liquidity, FPI). I DID include India-side commodity-price formation edges that no other part is likely to own and that the global chains need to land on the named Indian price drivers: F_COAL_INDIA->F_POWER_PRICE_IN, F_POWER_DEMAND_IN->F_POWER_PRICE_IN/F_COAL_INDIA, F_GDP_IN->F_POWER_DEMAND_IN, F_MONSOON->F_POWER_*/F_FOOD_INFLATION_IN/F_DAIRY, F_GOVT_CAPEX->F_STEEL_INDIA, F_DAIRY->F_FOOD_INFLATION_IN and F_FOOD_INFLATION_IN->F_CPI_IN (identity). Director: if the India part has the same pairs, keep one (prefer the better-sourced). NOT included (India part): CPI->repo, repo->G-sec/credit/housing, fiscal edges, P_FUEL_TAX_IN->CPI.

ALIASES. F_US_GDP~C_USA, F_EU_GDP~C_EU_UK, F_CHINA_GDP~C_CHINA have identical SSUs; I added one-way alias edges (w=1) so shocks reach companies attached to C_*. Recommended: merge the pairs and delete the 3 alias edges, otherwise companies attached to both will be double counted.

SERIES PROXY PROBLEMS for the empirical stage: F_GAS_GLOBAL=NG=F is Henry Hub (India-relevant is JKM/oil-indexed LNG; Brent beta ~0 empirically); F_STEEL_GLOBAL=HRC=F is US Midwest HRC behind 50% Sec-232 tariffs (India-relevant is China/Asia export HRC); F_REFINING_MARGIN=HO=F is the heating-oil PRICE, not a crack (use HO-Brent or Singapore GRM); F_EDIBLE_OIL=ZS=F is soybeans (use palm oil FCPO / soy oil ZL=F); F_COAL_INTL=MTF=F stopped updating 2025-12-26; F_FED_FUNDS=^IRX is the 13-week bill. Empirical company betas on these nodes should be read with that in mind.

NODE-DEFINITION ISSUE. P_FUEL_TAX_IN mixes 'higher excise' and 'regulated squeeze on OMCs' in the same + direction, which respond oppositely to crude. I modelled Brent->P_FUEL_TAX_IN as the excise-relief reaction (w=-0.4, low). Suggest splitting into excise vs OMC under-recovery.

DESIGN. Policy-reaction/feedback edges included: F_STEEL_INDIA->P_STEEL_DUTY_IN (-0.3), F_USDINR->F_FPI_FLOWS (-0.3), F_USDINR->F_REPO_IN, F_USDINR->F_LIQUIDITY_IN, F_USDINR->P_GOLD_IMPORT_DUTY, F_EDIBLE_OIL/F_FOOD_INFLATION_IN->NEW_AGRI_IMPORT_DUTY_IN, F_FOOD_INFLATION_IN->P_WINDFALL_EXPORT_TAX, F_FERTILISER_INPUTS->P_FERT_SUBSIDY, F_SUGAR->P_SUGAR_ETHANOL, F_BRENT->P_FUEL_TAX_IN, F_US_GDP->F_FED_FUNDS. All 2-node loops have |w| product <= 0.18; spectral radius of the full weight matrix is reported below. To avoid A->C duplication I kept direct edges only for channels not carried by an intermediate (e.g. China growth->global HRC direct is only +0.15 because the export and ore/coking-coal channels carry the rest; Brent->CPI excludes the INR channel; VIX->INR has no direct edge because the empirical beta is ~0 and the FPI path carries it). Geopolitical 'step' SSUs are vague; weights are calibrated to observed 2022-2026 episodes and ranges are deliberately wide. Biggest uncertainties: C_MIDEAST_CONFLICT->F_BRENT (regime-dependent, tail +35%), C_RED_SEA->F_SHIPPING_RATES, policy-reaction magnitudes, and US tariff->India GDP.
